title: San Juan Del Sur
style: Latin jazz rap, soul hip hop, smooth saxophone solo, heavy 808 bass, jazzy piano chords, chill beach atmosphere, bilingual Spanish and English lyrics, soulful swagger
lyrics:
[Intro]
(Smooth saxophone melody over a crackling vinyl beat)
Yeah, from the bay to the world
San Juan Del Sur
Rafa the Rapper, soul swagger
Escucha...

[Verse 1]
Caminando por la bahía, feeling the breeze
Bajo el sol de Nicaragua, I'm doing it with ease
The lifestyle is sweet, la vida es una joya
Watching the sunset desde la orilla de la hoya
Tengo el soul en la sangre, jazz in my veins
Breaking the locks and shaking the chains
From the statue of the Christ looking down on the shore
Busco la paz y siempre quiero más, much more.

[Chorus]
San Juan Del Sur, donde el alma se libera
Under the moon, la noche entera
Rhymes in English, flow en español
With that 808 heart and a jazzy soul
Es el ritmo del puerto, the sound of the wave
Rafa bringing the heat that you crave.

[Verse 2]
Saxophone screaming while the 808 thumps
Giving you the vibe and the lyrical jumps
English licks on the beat, then I switch to the native
Nicaragüense, siempre creative
I say 'sky' and then I touch el 'cielo'
Keeping it cool, flow bajo cero
From Maderas to Marsella, the swagger is real
You know the vibe, you know the feel.

[Chorus]
San Juan Del Sur, donde el alma se libera
Under the moon, la noche entera
Rhymes in English, flow en español
With that 808 heart and a jazzy soul
Es el ritmo del puerto, the sound of the wave
Rafa bringing the heat that you crave.

[Outro]
(Saxophone solo fades out with deep 808 kicks)
Yeah...
Jazz soul, Pacific coast.
Rafa the Rapper.
Nicaragua en la casa.
Pura vida, pure soul.
[End]
